blog_posts.title: 5 reasons you need fiber internet
blog_posts.excerpt: Why it is time to switch from copper broadband to fiber-optic internet.
blog_posts.content:
Fiber-optic internet is far faster and more stable than traditional copper connections. Latency is lower, upload and download speeds are symmetrical, and weather has far less impact.

On the EasyLink FTTH network you get unlimited plans from 10 Mbps up to 35 Mbps and beyond — ideal for multiple devices, 4K streaming and online gaming.

blog_posts.content:
Responding to the gaming community, EasyLink has launched low-latency optimized gaming packages. They include priority routing, direct peering with popular game servers and 24/7 priority support.

Check whether service is available in your area and order today.

blog_posts.title: How to choose the best internet plan for your home office
blog_posts.excerpt: A simple guide to picking the right speed and plan for working from home.
blog_posts.content:
When choosing an internet plan for a home office, three things matter most: upload speed, stability and latency.

For video conferencing, cloud file sync and VPN use, we recommend a plan with at least 40 Mbps of symmetrical speed.
